summary: In July 2013 more than a hundred neighbours, merchants, designers and city staff gathered to open the Portola's new park. In 2019 the Board made 770 Woolsey Street — the old University Mound Nursery — a landmark, and approved a plaque set into the pavement on Silver Avenue for Salina Lam, a former pupil at Hillcrest Elementary School. In 2021 it held a hearing into years of municipal code violations at 2861-2899 San Bruno Avenue.
